title: Completion of coherent modules is an exact functor
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] and $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-coherent ideal. The functor $\mathit{Coh}(\mathcal O_X)\to\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] sending a coherent module $\mathcal F$ [pqf-def-coherent] to $(\mathcal F/\mathcal I^n\mathcal F)_n$ is exact in the abelian categories [def-sp-abelian].

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0881 (lemma-exact), affine reduction to Algebra Lemma 05EN (lemma-completion-flat)
